description: This file contains functions for disassembling x86 machine code, including disassembly of instructions, range disassembly, and handling instruction flow. It also includes internal helper functions for instruction analysis.

methods.name: x86_disasm
methods.description: Disassembles a single x86 instruction from a buffer at a given offset, filling an instruction structure.

methods.name: x86_disasm_range
methods.description: Disassembles a range of instructions in a buffer, invoking a callback for each instruction.

methods.name: x86_disasm_forward
methods.description: Disassembles instructions forward from a buffer, following control flow instructions, with optional custom resolution.

methods.name: x86_invariant_disasm
methods.description: Disassembles instructions into an invariant representation.

methods.name: x86_size_disasm
methods.description: Returns the size of a disassembled instruction.
